people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”
translations.bsb: Now then, be strong and courageous, for though Saul your lord is dead, the house of Judah has anointed me as their king.”
translations.kjv: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
translations.asv: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be ye valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
